question: The marks of P are 10 more than the marks of Q. The marks of Q are 10 more than half of the marks of P. The marks of Q are ____.
solution:
**Given:**

P = Q + 10

Q = (P ÷ 2) + 10

**Formula Used:**

Substitution method

**Calculation:**

⇒ P = Q + 10

⇒ Q = (P ÷ 2) + 10

⇒ Q = (Q + 10) ÷ 2 + 10

⇒ 2Q = Q + 10 + 20

⇒ 2Q = Q + 30

⇒ Q = 30

**∴ The correct answer is 30.**
